name: EXM_RESERVATION_ITEMS
description: This table contains information about reservation items such as air or rail travel segments.

columns.name: RESERVATION_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of a travel segment for a AIR or RAIL reservation.

columns.name: RES_BOOK_DESIG_CODE
columns.description: Reservation or booking designation code from Global Distribtuion System.

columns.name: NUM_IN_PARTY
columns.description: Number of travelers in the party.

columns.name: ITINERARY_RESERVATION_ID
columns.description: Air or rail reservation to which travel segment belongs.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ITEM_CONFIRMATION_NUM
columns.description: Confirmation number of AIR or RAIL reservation at the travel segment level.

columns.name: VALIDATION_FAILURE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether travel segment failed validation.

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Version number of imported reservation record.  This number is incremented every time that data in reservation has been updated in the travel partner system from which data was imported.

columns.name: MARKET_AIRLINE_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System marketing airline code for a flight.

columns.name: MARKET_AIRLINE_MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Merchant for marketing airline for air reservation. This column is populated only if match is found for market_airline_code against EXM_MERCHANTS table during itinerary validation process.

columns.name: OPERATING_AIRLINE_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System operating airline code for a flight.

columns.name: OPERATING_AIRLINE_MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Merchant for operating airline for air reservation. This column is populated only if match was found for operating_airline_code agaist EXM_MERCHANTS table during itinerary validation process.

columns.name: OPERATING_AIRLINE_NAME
columns.description: Operating airline name for a flight.

columns.name: FLIGHT_NUMBER
columns.description: Flight number for air travel segment.

columns.name: AIRCRAFT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System aircraft type code for airplane used in a flight.

columns.name: FARE_CLASS
columns.description: Travel fare class of the seat on a flight.

columns.name: FARE_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for the airline fare class.  This column is populated only if a match is found against FND_LOOKUPS table during the itinerary validation process.

columns.name: TRAIN_NUMBER
columns.description: Train number for rail travel segment.

columns.name: RAIL_VENDOR_CODE
columns.description: Global distribution system identifier for the rail vendor.

columns.name: RAIL_MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Merchant for rail reservation. This column is populated only if match was found for rail_vendor_code agaist EXM_MERCHANTS table during itinerary validation process.

columns.name: CONNECTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Connection indicator for non-direct travel segments, such as 'O' for outbound, 'I' for inbound, 'IO' for inbound-outbound for connecting stops.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_LOCATION_NAME
columns.description: Departure airport or train station name.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Code from Global Distribution System (GDS) of departure airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Departure date time in departure city local time.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_CITY
columns.description: Departure city name for airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_STATE
columns.description: Departure state or province name for airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_STATE_CODE
columns.description: Departure state or province code for airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_COUNTRY
columns.description: Departure country for airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Departure country code for airport or train station.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical flight or rail departure location in Oracle Trading Community Architecture (TCA).  This column will only be populated if a geographical match is found in TCA using departure city, state or province, and country as part of the travel itinerary validation process.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_LOCATION_NAME
columns.description: Arrival airport or train station name.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Arrival airport or train station code.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Arrival date and time in arrival city.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_CITY
columns.description: Arrival city for airport or train station.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_STATE
columns.description: Arrival state or province name for airport or train station.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_STATE_CODE
columns.description: Arrival state or province code for airport or train station.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_COUNTRY
columns.description: Arrival country for airport or train station.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Arrival country code for airport or train station.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical flight or rail arrival location in Oracle Trading Community Architecture (TCA).  This column will only be populated if a geographical match is found in TCA using arrival city, state or province, and country as part of the travel itinerary validation process.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION
columns.description: Policy violation text displayed to employee while booking this reservation.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION_CODE
columns.description: Policy violation lookup code that maps to  policy violation text. This column is populated only if match is found against FND_LOOKUPS during itinerary validation process.
